{{Quote|I cannot say, young gentle. You must speak to my mistress, Lady Ucce.|Lady Ucce's servant|<ref name="Crystal" />}}
A '''servant''' of the [[Slavery/Legends|slave trader]] [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Ucce]] was of a [[Species/Legends|species]] that had hairy protuberances. This individual traveled to [[Crseih Station]] aboard her [[Lady Ucce's starship|starship]], and was on board when [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] boarded, seeking the whereabouts of her kidnapped children.

==Biography==
In [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]], this individual served [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Ucce]], a [[Slavery/Legends|slave trader]] and supporter of the underground [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] movement known as the [[Empire Reborn]]. That group, headed by [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Hethrir]], sought to oust the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and replace it with a new Empire with the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Hethrir as its [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]. The movement was financed by [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] in slaves, patronized by Lady Ucce and other Imperial nobility. Ucce and her servant traveled to [[Crseih Station]] to witness the [[Death/Legends|sacrifice]] of [[Anakin Solo]], son of New Republic [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], by Hethrir to the [[Waru]], a being from a [[Waru's universe|parallel universe]]. The servant stayed behind on Ucce's [[Lady Ucce's starship|golden starship]] and encountered Organa Solo. In the belief that Organa Solo was interested in purchasing slaves, the servant directed her to find Lady Ucce at the [[Crater Lodge]].<ref name="Crystal" />

==Personality and traits==
===Physical appearance===
Lady Ucce's servant was a member of a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] with [[Hair/Legends|hairy]], flexible [[Limb/Legends|protuberances]], each of which terminated in a starburst of fleshy tendrils. Those appendages functioned as sensory organs: the tendrils inclined in the direction in which the individual focused the senses and wriggled. The servant was capable of speaking [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]].<ref name="Crystal" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Vonda N. McIntyre]] created this character for her novel ''[[The Crystal Star]]'', published in [[1994]] by [[Bantam Spectra]]. The character, and its species, were not named.
